title: Siege of Toyama
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Toyama", at revision 1370745965, opens: "The siege of Toyama was a battle during the Azuchi-Momoyama period of Japan." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q997625, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1585 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
